comparison.objective: Loosen a captive nut with a selected wrench and swing a latch arm open; candidate replaces a harness connector.
comparison.physical_skill: Wrench fitting, torque-limited turning, and arm articulation versus connector latch manipulation and controlled mating.
comparison.success_condition: PR measures nut backoff, arm angle, clearance, dwell, rounding, and force limits; candidate has no connector-specific thresholds or inspection criteria.
comparison.reason: Fastener release and arm opening test a different contact sequence from connector extraction and installation.
